title: 第19章 七大长老第20章 风暴来临
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
“殷老五，起来了，你这醉鬼难道不知道试炼要开启了吗？”
庭院尽头玉栏外的慕容仙儿对着一座高楼大喝，左丘辰木讷的呆在一旁，自始至终都是一副震惊的表情。
他的认知中，客卿长老地位不是要低于正派长老吗？可是看了刚才徐长老的表现和现在慕容仙儿这样大喝第五长老，他一时有点摸不着头脑。
且慕容仙儿一路走来都是大摇大摆，甚至像是大王巡山，走到一处便大喝，而且表现的还不是一种态度，如现在在这高楼下插腰大喝，看上去比较刁蛮任性。
“大清早的谁这么不开眼啊，是不是找死！”
“你谁啊？你....仙儿长老！”
“见过仙儿长老！”
阁楼上一个满脸胡茬的大汉探出头，且一身酒气弥漫对着左丘辰二人所处之地发怒，借着那股酒劲，言语中的怒火如同火山爆发，但是下一瞬间，在左丘辰惊愕的神情中。
那个中年彪悍男子居然一脸严肃，握紧酒壶抱拳对着慕容仙儿问好。
“信不信姑奶奶拆了你这醉心居？”
慕容仙儿腮帮子鼓动，丝毫不像一个强者模样，当然这是左丘辰看来，可是阁楼上那醉汉却是眼带惊恐。
“别别别，仙子，不姑奶奶，姑奶奶我起来，我去护院好不好...”
慕容仙儿瞪眼，然后转身离去，左丘辰快步跟上，他完全不懂这“姑奶奶”的节奏，只有默默跟随。
“记住这个地方，还有你看过的北宣学院地图，虽然近百年改建过，但名字没变。”
左丘辰小鸡啄米般点头，的确他被这个霸气外露的仙儿长老震慑到了，不知何时冷汗已然从额头冒起。
走在长廊前方的慕容仙儿偷笑，暗道我就是这样强势，咋地，但实际是带左丘辰熟悉北宣学院，目的是好的，只是手段过于自我，但这正是慕容仙儿的行事之风。
穿过长廊，两旁假山流水逝去，经过一片花圃之地后，传来花香，抬头看去，红色木楼如画般矗立，阵阵芳香传来，慕容仙儿微笑，然后快速朝前而去。
“锦绣阁还是这般，我若是学院弟子当然也选这里，真美。”
“呵呵，仙儿妹妹调皮了，果真来了我锦绣阁，见你本人还真与那传说中不一样。”
远方传来嬉笑声，紧接着一位红袍妇人出现，左丘辰望去，只见妇人盘发，头顶一根白色玉簪穿过秀发，虽然打扮成熟，但是脸上并未有太多岁月留下的痕迹，身着一身红袍更是亮眼。

“哇，姐姐好美啊，神交数日，现在才看见姐姐才知晓北宣学院第一美人果然名不虚传。”
慕容仙儿少女般嬉笑，然后上前握住红袍妇人双手，两人如同故交。
“少贫了，莫说北宣学院，现在北境第一美人是你才对。”
哪里都一样，女人相处之间少不了夸赞，红袍妇人对慕容仙儿的夸赞，让左丘辰心中一顿，暗道你要是知晓她半个时辰前彪悍的样子或许你就不会这样说了。
豁然一双美目转头，左丘辰心惊，他不知道慕容仙儿时时刻刻神识查探着自己，当那双美目带着丝丝怒气袭来，左丘辰暗道不妙...
“仙子长老，是朝暮仙子，看啊她和红月长老好似认识。”
“仙儿长老真美，实力也强，怕是北境又要多一天骄了。”
木楼的窗口上探出花季的面孔，短短瞬间，木楼如同花圃之地的花朵片刻百花齐放，一张张好奇带着羡慕的脸张望。
“那个人是？”
“那是蝶儿所说的朝暮山唯一的男子，眼如星辰，俊美如画！”
“对啊，被仙儿长老带回朝暮山的少年。”
不单单慕容仙儿成为了焦点，在这锦绣阁，北宣学院女弟子住所处，左丘辰的出现瞬间也是吸引了众人。
慕容仙儿撇头眼中带笑看着左丘辰，那眼神似乎在说看吧，你小子也出名了。
“咳咳。”
左丘辰干咳，然后转身，显然他没料到会是这样一副场景。
“我北境天寒地冻，易出美人，但是没想到啊，仙儿妹妹，如今这样的公子玉让你寻到了，真是好福气。”
红袍妇人，也就是红月长老别有意思的对着慕容仙儿言道，虽然慕容仙儿从小在大族纷争中长大，什么场面没见过，但是这样的人情事故话语还是让慕容仙儿脸颊一红...
女人之间总是有说不完的话语，很快一个个时辰过去了，已经日上三竿了，慕容仙儿才渐渐离去，左丘辰叹气，为何尴尬的时间过得这么慢，足足两个时辰啊...
从开始到现在，左丘辰也知晓太多，原来慕容仙儿是新入主的长老，但是实力强大一人独占朝暮山，而北宣学院默认她为长老，且按照实力来讲她超过七大长老，在一个很玄妙的位置。
content_en:
"Yin Laowu, get up. Don't you, a drunkard, know that the trial is about to begin?"
Murong Xian'er was shouting at a tall building outside the jade fence at the end of the courtyard, while Zuo Qiuchen stood aside dully, with a shocked expression from beginning to end.
In his opinion, isn't the status of the guest elders lower than that of the upright elders? But after seeing Elder Xu's behavior just now and Murong Xianer yelling at the fifth elder now, he was a little confused for a moment.
Moreover, Murong Xian'er walked in a swaggering manner, even like a king patrolling the mountains. He shouted loudly when he went to a place, and it was not an attitude. If he was shouting at the high building now, he looked more unruly and willful.
"Who is so blind this early in the morning? Are you looking for death?"
"Who are you? You...Elder Xian'er!"
"I've met Elder Xian'er!"
A burly man with a stubble on his face poked his head out from the attic, and smelled of alcohol and was angry at the place where Zuo Qiuchen and Zuo Qiuchen were. With the alcohol, the anger in his words was like a volcano erupting, but the next moment, in Zuo Qiuchen's shocked expression.
The sturdy middle-aged man actually had a serious look on his face. He clenched his wine bottle and raised his fists to say hello to Murong Xian'er.
"Believe it or not, my aunt demolished your drunken house?"
Murong Xian'er's cheeks were twitching, and she didn't look like a strong man at all. Of course, this was Zuo Qiuchen's opinion, but the drunk man in the attic had frightened eyes.
"No, no, no, fairy, aunt, aunt, let me get up and go to the nursing home, okay..."
Murong Xian'er stared, then turned and left. Zuo Qiuchen quickly followed. He didn't understand the rhythm of this "aunt" at all, so he could only follow silently.
"Remember this place and the map of Beixuan College you have seen. Although it has been renovated in the past hundred years, the name has not changed."
Zuo Qiuchen nodded like a chicken pecking at rice. He was indeed shocked by this domineering elder Xian'er, and cold sweat broke out on his forehead before he knew it.
Murong Xian'er, who was walking in front of the corridor, snickered and thought to herself that I am so strong, blah, blah, but in reality, I was bringing Zuo Qiuchen to get familiar with Beixuan College. The purpose was good, but the method was too selfish, but this is the way Murong Xian'er behaves.
Passing through the corridor, the rockeries and flowing water on both sides passed by. After passing a flower garden, the fragrance of flowers came. Looking up, the red wooden building stood like a painting. The fragrance came. Murong Xianer smiled, and then quickly walked forward.
"Jinxiu Pavilion is still like this. If I were an academy disciple, of course I would choose this place. It's so beautiful."
"Haha, sister Xian'er is naughty. You really came to our Jinxiu Pavilion, and you are really different from the legend."
Laughter came from the distance, and then a woman in red robe appeared. Zuo Qiuchen looked around and saw that the woman had her hair tied up, with a white hosta running through her hair. Although she was dressed maturely, there were not many traces of time on her face, and she was even more dazzling in a red robe.
"Wow, my sister is so beautiful. I have known her for several days. Only now that I see my sister do I realize that the most beautiful woman in Beixuan College is indeed well-deserved."
Murong Xian'er laughed like a girl, then stepped forward to hold the red-robed woman's hands, and the two seemed like old friends.
"Don't be poor anymore. Don't talk about Bei Propaganda College. You are the most beautiful woman in the North right now."
It's the same everywhere, compliments are indispensable when getting along with women. The woman in red robe praised Murong Xian'er, which made Zuo Qiuchen feel stunned and thought to himself, if you had known how tough she looked half an hour ago, maybe you wouldn't have said that.
Suddenly a pair of beautiful eyes turned around, Zuo Qiuchen was frightened. He didn't know that Murong Xian'er's consciousness was always checking him. When those beautiful eyes came with a trace of anger, Zuo Qiuchen secretly thought something was wrong...
"Elder Fairy, this is Fairy Chaomu. It seems like she and Elder Hongyue know each other."
"Elder Xian'er is so beautiful and powerful. I'm afraid the Northern Territory will have another genius."
The face of the flower season peeked out from the window of the wooden building. In just a short moment, the wooden building was like a flower garden in which a hundred flowers bloomed.Qi looked with envy on his face.
"Who is that person?"
"That's the only man in Chaomu Mountain that Die'er said. He has eyes like stars and is as handsome as a painting!"
"Yes, the young man who was brought back to Chaomu Mountain by Elder Xian'er."
Not only did Murong Xianer become the focus, Zuo Qiuchen's appearance in Jinxiu Pavilion, where the female disciples of Beixuan College lived, also attracted everyone.
Murong Xian'er turned her head and looked at Zuo Qiuchen with a smile in her eyes, her eyes seemed to say, look, you are also famous.
"Ahem."
Zuo Qiuchen coughed dryly and then turned around. Obviously he did not expect such a scene.
"It's cold in the north, and beauties are easy to come out, but I didn't expect it. Sister Xian'er, you are so lucky to have found such a young man."
The red-robed woman, Elder Hongyue, said something interesting to Murong Xianer. Although Murong Xianer grew up in the disputes of the big clans and had never seen any scenes, such words about human affairs still made Murong Xianer's cheeks turn red...
There are always endless words to say between women. Hours passed quickly, and it was already three o'clock in the morning. Murong Xian'er gradually left. Zuo Qiuchen sighed, why did the embarrassing time pass so slowly, a full two hours...
From the beginning to now, Zuo Qiuchen also knew too much. It turned out that Murong Xian'er was a new elder, but she was powerful enough to monopolize Chaomu Mountain. However, Beixuan College recognized her as an elder, and in terms of strength, she surpassed the seven elders, occupying a very mysterious position.
